controller: Privileged-state feedback PID; no training, perception, or real-aircraft validation

gain_units.kp: N m per unit rotation error

controller.name: Cascaded position PID and attitude PD with reference acceleration feedforward
controller.state_source: Exact simulator state; no perception, learning, or state estimator

coordinates.attitude: [roll,pitch,yaw] degrees, intrinsic ZYX / Rz(yaw) Ry(pitch) Rx(roll)
coordinates.body: Right-handed, x forward, y left, z up; centre of mass origin
coordinates.body_rates: [p,q,r] angular velocity about body x/y/z in rad/s; not Euler-angle derivatives
coordinates.world: Right-handed, z up; x/y horizontal; metres

equations.expression: e_p = p_ref - p; e_v = v_ref - v
equations.name: Position error

equations.expression: I = clamp(I + e_p dt); a_des = bound(a_ref + Kp e_p + Kd e_v + Ki I)
equations.name: Position controller
equations.note: Per-axis integral clamp, horizontal vector-norm bound, vertical scalar bounds; gains multiply per axis.

equations.name: Desired rotor force
equations.note: Desired body z follows normalized F_des; body x is aligned with projected world +x heading.

equations.name: Attitude error
equations.note: Body-frame rotation error; a sine-like error, not Euler-angle subtraction.

equations.name: Attitude controller
equations.note: Desired body moment before cyclic saturation and tail reaction compensation.

equations.expression: T_projected=max(0,F_des dot body_z); u_c=clip(T_projected/T_max); u_long=clip(tau_y/P_max); u_lat=clip(tau_x/R_max); u_tail=clip((tau_z+k_Q T_projected)/Q_tail_max)
equations.name: Control allocation
equations.note: Collective is [0,1]; three other channels are [-1,1]. Tail compensation uses projected thrust before collective saturation.

equations.name: Actuator response
equations.note: All four channels have the same first-order lag; applied forces use the updated actual values.

equations.name: Rotor forces
equations.note: Main thrust follows body z; a tail rotor at negative body x produces lateral force and yaw torque.

equations.name: Applied force
equations.note: This reported applied force excludes gravity and ground-contact forces, which MuJoCo adds.

equations.expression: tau_body=[R_max u_lat_actual,P_max u_long_actual,Q_tail-k_Q T]; tau_world=R tau_body-c_damp omega_world
equations.name: Applied moment
equations.note: Reported torque_body excludes damping; torque_world includes damping and excludes contact moments.

equations.expression: m dv/dt = F_world + m g_world + F_contact
equations.name: Rigid-body motion
equations.note: MuJoCo also integrates rotational rigid-body dynamics and quaternion attitude. No pose or velocity is assigned by the controller.

limitations: Reduced force/moment model: collective is linear thrust and cyclic is body moment, not a blade-element rotor calculation.
No rotor inflow, speed/governor dynamics, structural flex, sensor noise/delay or actuator failure model.
Only skids collide with the ground; no full fuselage or blade collision geometry.
Controller reads exact state and fixed nominal mass; this is simulated feedback control, not learned control or real-aircraft validation.
model.name: Reduced 6DoF main/tail-rotor helicopter

physics.mass_scaling: mass_scale multiplies all three inertias and mass; controller retains nominal mass

meanings.active: False when the controller is disabled or touchdown has cut the commands; desired quantities are then zero, while residual actuator forces and drag remain truthful.
meanings.actual_thrust_n: Main rotor thrust actually applied after actuator lag.
meanings.commanded_thrust_n: Bounded collective command multiplied by maximum main thrust, before actuator lag.
meanings.desired_acceleration: Position-controller output after acceleration bounds, before gravity compensation.
meanings.desired_force_world: Nominal mass times gravity-compensated desired acceleration, before projection onto current rotor axis.
meanings.desired_torque_body: Attitude-controller moment before allocation and actuator limits.
meanings.force_body: Actual main and tail rotor forces; excludes aerodynamic drag, gravity and contact.
meanings.force_world: Actual rotated rotor force plus wind-relative drag; excludes gravity and contact.
meanings.position_integral: The stored, clamped position-error integral; updated before active control and retained, but not used, while inactive.
meanings.projected_thrust_n: Nonnegative desired-force projection before collective saturation.
meanings.torque_body: Actual cyclic, tail and main reaction moments; excludes damping and contact.
meanings.torque_world: Actual rotated rotor moment plus angular damping; excludes contact.

telemetry.timing: Position, quaternion, velocity, attitude_deg, body_rates and reference are at state.time. solution contains values actually used immediately before the last integration, at solution.time = state.time - timestep_s. solution.available is false before the first step.

units.attitude_error_body: dimensionless; approximately radians for small rotations

simulator: MuJoCo rigid body with reduced main/tail rotor force and moment model
